checks.name: CheckoutQuote_amounts_check
checks.definition: CHECK (((quantity = 1) AND (currency = 'NAD'::text) AND ("sourceZarCents" > 0) AND ("totalCents" = "sourceZarCents") AND ("displayCents" > 0) AND ("displayCurrency" = ANY (ARRAY['USD'::text, 'NAD'::text, 'ZAR'::text, 'EUR'::text, 'GBP'::text]))))

checks.name: affiliate_checkout_snapshot_valid
checks.definition: CHECK (((("affiliateId" IS NULL) AND ("affiliateCode" IS NULL) AND ("affiliateRateBps" IS NULL) AND ("affiliateSource" IS NULL)) OR (("affiliateId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("affiliateCode" IS NOT NULL) AND ("affiliateRateBps" IS NOT NULL) AND ("affiliateSource" IS NOT NULL) AND (("affiliateRateBps" >= 1) AND ("affiliateRateBps" <= 10000)) AND (((intent = 'purchase'::text) AND ("affiliateSource" = ANY (ARRAY['code'::text, 'cookie'::text]))) OR ((intent = 'top-up'::text) AND ("affiliateSource" = 'original-order'::text) AND ("topUpForOrderId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("topUpForIccid" IS NOT NULL))))))

checks.name: affiliate_commission_valid
checks.definition: CHECK ((("saleCents" > 0) AND (("rateBps" >= 1) AND ("rateBps" <= 10000)) AND ("commissionCents" >= 0) AND (("refundedSaleCents" >= 0) AND ("refundedSaleCents" <= "saleCents")) AND (("commissionCents")::numeric = floor(((((("saleCents")::bigint * "rateBps") + 5000))::numeric / (10000)::numeric))) AND ("availableAt" = ("fulfilledAt" + '30 days'::interval))))

checks.name: affiliate_ledger_adjustment_valid
checks.definition: CHECK ((((kind = 'refund'::text) AND ("adjustmentId" IS NOT NULL)) OR ((kind = 'commission'::text) AND ("adjustmentId" IS NULL))))

checks.name: affiliate_ledger_valid
checks.definition: CHECK ((((kind = 'commission'::text) AND ("amountCents" >= 0) AND ("saleRefundCents" = 0)) OR ((kind = 'refund'::text) AND ("amountCents" <= 0) AND ("saleRefundCents" > 0) AND (reference IS NOT NULL) AND (reason IS NOT NULL))))

checks.name: affiliate_payout_valid
checks.definition: CHECK ((("amountCents" > 0) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['prepared'::text, 'processing'::text, 'paid'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND ((status <> 'paid'::text) OR (("paidAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("transferReference" IS NOT NULL) AND ("transferAmount" IS NOT NULL) AND ("transferAmount" > (0)::numeric) AND ("transferCurrency" IS NOT NULL) AND ("exchangeRate" IS NOT NULL) AND ("exchangeRate" > (0)::numeric) AND (fees IS NOT NULL) AND (fees >= (0)::numeric)))))

checks.name: affiliate_profile_valid
checks.definition: CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'approved'::text, 'rejected'::text, 'suspended'::text])) AND (code ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{8,32}$'::text) AND (("rateOverrideBps" IS NULL) OR (("rateOverrideBps" >= 1) AND ("rateOverrideBps" <= 10000)))))

checks.name: affiliate_settings_valid
checks.definition: CHECK (((id = 'program'::text) AND (("defaultRateBps" IS NULL) OR (("defaultRateBps" >= 1) AND ("defaultRateBps" <= 10000))) AND ((NOT enabled) OR ("defaultRateBps" IS NOT NULL))))

triggers.name: affiliate_checkout_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER affiliate_checkout_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON public."CheckoutSession" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION affiliate_frozen_checkout()

triggers.name: affiliate_commission_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER affiliate_commission_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON public."AffiliateCommission" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION affiliate_frozen_commission()

triggers.name: affiliate_fulfilment_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER affiliate_fulfilment_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON public."EsimOrder" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION affiliate_frozen_fulfilment()

triggers.name: affiliate_ledger_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER affiliate_ledger_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public."AffiliateLedgerEntry" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION affiliate_immutable_ledger()

triggers.name: affiliate_sale_adjustment_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER affiliate_sale_adjustment_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public."AffiliateSaleAdjustment" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION affiliate_immutable_ledger()

indexes.name: "AffiliatePayoutAllocation_active_entry_key"
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "AffiliatePayoutAllocation_active_entry_key" ON public."AffiliatePayoutAllocation" USING btree ("ledgerEntryId") WHERE ("releasedAt" IS NULL)
